title: C-3PO
description: C-3P0 was a worry-prone Droid programmed for etiquette and protocol, yet he found himself in the service of the Rebellion against the Empire. That's how he came into the service of Luke Skywalker, a young farmboy on Tatooine. Along with his constant companion, R2-D2, he accompanied Luke to meet Obi-Wan Kenobi, to the Death Star, and ultimately to save the galaxy.
